GUI.note:
Assessment
Ester Angulo (DOB 1987-02-10, MRN SYN-8627959) is a 37-year-old female referred for evaluation of a 5-month history of near-daily urticarial lesions refractory to cetirizine 10 mg BID and recurring within 1 week of stopping a 5-day course of prednisone 40 mg daily.

1. Evaluation for Chronic Spontaneous Urticaria (CSU) vs. Urticarial Vasculitis & Mimics:
- Does NOT meet criteria for uncomplicated Chronic Spontaneous Urticaria (CSU): In CSU, individual wheals are transient (<24 hours), predominantly pruritic, and resolve completely without residual skin changes.
- Clinical & Laboratory Features Strongly Suggest Hypocomplementemic Urticarial Vasculitis (HUV):
  * Individual lesions persist >24-48 hours (patient reports 2-4 days; 2024-05-28 nurse lesion check confirmed a marked left thigh plaque remained unchanged at 48 hours).
  * Lesions are characterized by burning and tenderness rather than pure pruritus.
  * Lesions heal with residual purpura at the wheal edge and brownish post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation/bruise-like marks.
  * Extracutaneous systemic manifestations: Morning inflammatory arthralgias and mild tenderness of bilateral knees and small joints of the hand
